name: ai-content-labels
description: Label AI-generated and human-made content with the official EU icons, from any AI agent. Decide what the AI Act asks for, burn the label into images in one call, and get the alt text. CLI, MCP server (stdio and HTTP), Node library and Agent Skill.
author: JK-G (https://github.com/JK-G)
